subject: Geography
question_text_en: Consider the following statements about divergent plate boundaries and sea-floor spreading. Which statement correctly explains the mapped pattern of new crust along mid-ocean ridges?
option_a: New crust forms where two plates converge at a trench
option_b: New crust forms where plates separate and magma rises along a ridge
option_c: Old crust remains fixed while continental margins move randomly
option_d: Transform boundaries create new crust through lateral displacement
explanation_en: At a divergent boundary plates separate and magma rises along the ridge. The cooling process creates new oceanic crust; therefore the mapped age pattern becomes progressively older away from the ridge axis.
